s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of diffuse abdominal pain and fever with evidence of free intraperitoneal air
key_facts: 13 similar admissions with abdominal pain over 11 years
Previous episodes resolved with conservative management
Free intraperitoneal air on erect chest radiograph or abdominal CT
Diagnostic laparoscopy in 2010 showed no visceral perforation or other pathology
